source.primary_witnesses: 11Q12 (Jubilees from Cave 11) preserves sparse fragments touching this chapter — most notably small portions around the Watchers material (Jub 5:1-12). Where 11Q12 preserves Hebrew, Hebrew is primary; otherwise Ge'ez (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511 critical edition) is primary. Greek not preserved for this chapter.
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Hebrew SBL/Sefaria; Ge'ez SBL.

source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 5 — **THE WATCHERS-AND-DAUGHTERS-OF-MEN NARRATIVE (vv 1-12, parallel to 1 En 6-11) + THE FLOOD (vv 19-32) + HEAVENLY TABLETS REFERENCE (5:13).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS CHAPTER** — bidirectional with v2.66.0 `watchers-1-enoch-6-11-bnei-elohim-cross-corpus` and v2.67.0 `heavenly-tablets-1-enoch-81-jubilees-daniel-revelation-cross-corpus`. **CRITICAL: Jub 5 PARALLELS but does NOT identically reproduce 1 En 6-11.** The Watchers material is presented compactly; the 1 Enoch elaborate-list-of-rebel-angels is OMITTED in Jubilees. Jubilees presents the giants and the Flood as ONE NARRATIVE-FLOW; 1 Enoch separates them into distinct sub-narratives. **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entries on the Watchers, the giants becoming evil spirits, and the cosmic-rebellion etiology.**

verses.text: ויהי כי החלו בני האדם לרב על פני האדמה ובנות נולדו להם וירואו מלאכי האלהים בשנה אחת ביובל הזה כי טובות הן ויקחו להם נשים מכל אשר בחרו ותלדנה להם בנים והמה הגיברים
verses.translit: wa-yhī kī hēḥēllū bənē hā-ʾādām lā-rōb ʿal pənē hā-ʾădāmāh ū-bānōt nōlədū lā-hem wa-yirʾū malʾăkē hā-ʾĕlōhīm bə-šānāh ʾaḥat ba-yōbēl ha-zeh kī ṭōbōt hēn wa-yiqqəḥū lā-hem nāšīm mi-kol ʾăšer bāḥărū wa-tēlaḏnāh lā-hem bānīm wə-hēmmāh ha-gibbōrīm
verses.text_geez: ወኮነ፡ አመ፡ አኀዙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይብዝኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ወአዋልድ፡ ተወልዳ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወርእይዎን፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ በዓመት፡ አሐደ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ከመ፡ ሠናያት፡ እማንቱ፡ ወነሥእዎን፡ ሎሙ፡ አንስቲያ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሎን፡ ዘኀረዩ፡ ወወለዳ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወእሙንቱ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኄሊያን፡
verses.witness_primary: 11Q12 frag 8 lines 1-4 (García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 224-227) — Hebrew partially preserves the WATCHERS-DAUGHTERS-OF-MEN narrative; key vocabulary בנות נולדו 'daughters were born' + מלאכי האלהים 'angels of God' attested
verses.notes: **THE WATCHERS DESCEND. THE ANGELIC FORNICATION. THE GIBBORIM ARE BORN.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUB 5:1 IS THE PRINCIPAL HEBREW JUBILEES-COMPRESSION OF GEN 6:1-4 + 1 EN 6-7.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `watchers-1-enoch-6-11-bnei-elohim-cross-corpus`.** **The Ge'ez 'angels of God' (malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ) where Gen 6:2 MT has בני האלהים 'sons of God'** — Jubilees follows the LXX/Symmachus 'angels of God' reading rather than 'sons of God,' explicitly identifying the Watchers as angels. **CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY**: cf. Gen 6:1-4; cf. 1 En 6:1-2, 7:1-2 (the 200 Watchers descend on Mt Hermon and take wives); cf. 4Q201-4Q202 Aramaic 1 Enoch fragments preserving the Watchers list; cf. CD 2:17-21 (Damascus Document on Watchers); cf. Bar 3:26-28 (giants who fell); cf. 1 Pet 3:19-20, 2 Pet 2:4, Jude 6-7 (Watchers' judgment); cf. Test. Reuben 5:6-7 (Watchers + women + Tower of Babel cluster).

verses.text_geez: ወረሥሐት፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ኂሩተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኮነ፡ እኩየ፡ ዘልፈ፡
verses.translit: wa-rasḥat kwəlu śəgā fənoto ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr kwəlomu ḫadagu śərʿatomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətballāʿ ʾaḥadu kāləʾo wa-ʾabasa ʿamaḍā lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlu ḫəllinā-hu la-kwəlu ḥirūta daqiqa sabʾ kona ʾəkkuya zalfa
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 5:2; VanderKam 1989) — 11Q12 lacunose at this verse
verses.notes: **ALL FLESH CORRUPTED ITS WAY — humans, beasts, cattle, birds, all creeping things. They abandoned their order and began to devour one another. The thought of every desire of mankind was continually evil.** **CROSS-CORPUS — UNIVERSAL CORRUPTION**: directly cites Gen 6:5 ('every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually') + Gen 6:12 ('all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth'). **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: 'they began to devour one another'** — explicit cannibalism + carnivory extending to all flesh. **CROSS-CORPUS to 1 En 7:5** ('the giants devoured the labor of all men... and they began to sin against birds and beasts and reptiles and fish, and to devour one another's flesh, and drink the blood'). **Cf. Jub 7:24** below for Noah's recapitulation.

verses.text_geez: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአንሰ፡ አስተራኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ካልአ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኅሉፋን፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
verses.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ manfasa lāʿla kwəlu sabʾ wa-ʾansa ʾastarāʾi lāʿla kwəlu śəgā ʾəmdəḫrazə kidāna kāləʾa məsla sabʾ la-mawāʿəl kwəlomu ḫəlufān məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata
verses.notes: **God SETS SPIRIT/JUDGMENT OVER ALL FLESH; 120-YEAR LIMIT.** Direct citation of Gen 6:3 ('my spirit shall not abide in man forever... his days shall be 120 years'). The 120-year human-lifespan limit.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አኀዝት፡ ምድር፡ ለመውዓ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ዘፈጠርኩ፡ እምሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ እስመ፡ ነስሕኩ፡ ከመ፡ ገበርክዎሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾaḫaztu mədr la-mawʿā sabʾ ʾəm-nə gaṣṣa mədr za-faṭarku ʾəm-sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-ʾaʿwāfa samāy ʾəsma nashku kama gabarkəwomu
verses.notes: **God's decision to blot out humanity + animals + birds: 'I have repented that I made them.'** Direct citation of Gen 6:7. The divine-repentance theme.

verses.text_geez: ወአምልክት፡ ኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ እግዚእ፡ ብርየ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ በትውልዱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ፍጹም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾamləkta Noḫ qədma gaṣṣa ʾəgziʾ bərya wa-bəʾəsi ṣādəq ba-təwludu bəʾəsi fəṣṣum
verses.notes: **Noah finds favor before God; righteous and perfect in his generation.** Direct citation of Gen 6:8-9.

verses.text_geez: ወላዕለ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ኒሁ፡ እለ፡ ፈነወ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ ተምዕዐ፡ ጥቀ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምኦሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወሤሞሙ፡ ኀቤነ፡ ከመ፡ ናሰስሎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ጥልቅ፡ ዓለም፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-lāʿla malāʾəktihu naḫu ʾəlla fanawa ḫaba mədr tamʿəʿa ṭəqqa kama yəssamʾomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-śēmomu ḫabēna kama nāsasələmu wəsta ṭəlq ʿālam ʾəska ʿəlata ʿabəy kwənnānē
verses.notes: **WATCHERS BOUND IN THE DEEP UNTIL THE GREAT JUDGMENT.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — WATCHERS' IMPRISONMENT**: 'against his angels, indeed those whom he sent down to earth, he was greatly angered, so that he would deport them from all their stations, and he commanded us [the holy angels] to bind them in the depths of the earth until the day of the great judgment.' **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 10:11-12 (Michael commanded to bind Semihazah and the Watchers); cf. 1 En 21:1-10 (place of imprisonment); cf. 2 Pet 2:4 ('cast them into Tartarus, delivered them into chains of nether darkness'); cf. Jude 6 ('he has kept in eternal chains under darkness until the judgment of the great day' — VERY close verbal parallel to Jubilees 5:6). **Jude 6 likely cites Jubilees here as one of its sources.**

verses.text_geez: ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ ወፅአ፡ ቃል፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ከመ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወከመ፡ ይስስሉ፡ እምነ፡ ታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-lāʿla daqiqomu waḍʾa qāl ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kama yətqattalu ba-sayf wa-kama yəssaslu ʾəm-nə tāḥta samāy
verses.notes: **'And against their sons [the giants] a word came forth from his presence that they should be struck with the sword and removed from under heaven.'** Mutual-slaughter of the giants. cf. 1 En 10:9-10 (Gabriel commanded to incite mutual war among the giants).

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ ኢይነብር፡ መንፈስየ፡ በሰብእ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ሥጋሰ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē ʾi-yənabbər manfasəya ba-sabʾ la-ʿālam ʾəsma śəgāsa ʾəmuntu wa-yəkunu mawāʿəlihomu məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata
verses.notes: **120-year lifespan reiterated.** Repetition of v. 3.

verses.text_geez: ወፈነወ፡ ሰይፍ፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ሰይፈ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ እስከ፡ ወድቁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-fanawa sayf ba-māʾkalomu kama yəgbar ʾaḥadu kāləʾo sayfa wa-ʾaḫazu yətqattalu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo ʾəska wadqu kwəlomu ba-sayf wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəm-nə mədr
verses.notes: **The giants fall by mutual sword-slaughter — the GIANTS WAR.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — GIANTS WAR**: cf. 1 En 10:9-10; cf. the Book of Giants (4Q203, 4Q530-4Q533) — extensively concerned with the giants' history. **Mutual destruction of the giants is the etiology of pre-Flood violence**: 'the earth was filled with violence' (Gen 6:11).

verses.text_geez: ወአበዊሆሙ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይርእዩ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾabawihomu konu yərʾəyu wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəmdəḫrazə ba-wəsta mədr ʾəm-nə qədma ʾəgziʾ wa-ʾastaʾtatomu kāʿba lāʿla kwəlu gəbər zagabru ʾəkkuya
verses.notes: **The Watchers (the fathers) WATCH their giant-sons destroy each other from their imprisonment.** Continuation of mutual-slaughter narrative.

verses.text_geez: ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተርፈ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘኢመነኖ፡ በከመ፡ መንኖሙ፡ በከመ፡ መጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾastaʾtatomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-ʾalbo zatarfa ʾəmənnehomu zaʾi-mannano ba-kama mannanomu ba-kama maṭan kwəlu gəbromu
verses.notes: **'And he removed them from all their stations; none were left whom he did not judge.'** Comprehensive judgment-completion.

verses.text_geez: ወገብረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኬሐሉ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ በኵሉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወከመ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ በዘዘዚአሁ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ዘልፈ፡
verses.translit: wa-gabra lāʿla kwəlu gəbromu śərʿata ḥaddisa wa-rətʿa kama ʾi-yəkēḥalu la-ḫāṭiʾat ba-kwəlu śərʿatomu ʾəska la-ʿālam wa-kama yəkunu kwəlomu ṣādəqāna ba-zazazaʾahu gəʿz zalfa
verses.notes: **'New nature' (śərʿata ḥaddisa = new order) imposed on all creation — they cannot sin against their nature forever.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — POST-FLOOD COSMIC RE-ORDERING**: 'a new order' established to prevent future Watcher-style cosmic transgression. cf. Gen 9:1-17 (Noachic covenant); cf. 2 Pet 3:13 ('new heavens and new earth wherein dwells righteousness').

verses.text_geez: ወፍትሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ በከመ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ እምነ፡ ሕግ፡ ቦ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ጽሑፋን፡ በከመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-fətḥa kwəlu śəgā ṣəḥuf lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ba-kama śərʿatu la-kwəlu gəbər ba-kama ṣədq wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw ʾəm-nə ḥəg bo wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw kwəlomu zawəstatēhā ṣəḥufan ba-kama kwəlomu gəbromu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 5:13; VanderKam 1989) — note: this is one of the MOST CITED Jubilees verses in scholarship on heavenly-tablets motif
verses.notes: **MAJOR — THE JUDGMENT-OF-ALL-FLESH IS WRITTEN ON THE HEAVENLY TABLETS.** **THE CENTRAL HEAVENLY-TABLETS REFERENCE OF JUBILEES.** **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry `heavenly-tablets-1-enoch-81-jubilees-daniel-revelation-cross-corpus`.** All cosmic judgment is pre-inscribed on the heavenly tablets. No one transgresses without judgment. **CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY**: cf. 1 En 81:1-2, 93:2, 103:2-3, 106:19 (Enoch's heavenly tablets); cf. Dan 7:10 (books opened in judgment); cf. Mal 3:16 (book of remembrance); cf. Rev 5:1-7, 20:12 (sealed scrolls + books of judgment); cf. Ps 56:8, 139:16; cf. 4Q416, 4Q418 (4QInstruction — 'mystery of being' tied to heavenly inscription). **This verse is foundational to the entire Second Temple heavenly-tablets / cosmic-determinism tradition.**

verses.text_geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትኀደግ፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ለርእሰ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረሰየ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ሊቀ፡ መንፈስ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ጻድቅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalbo zayətḫaddag ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kwəlu gəbər la-rəʾəsa kwənnānē la-maṭan kwəlu gəbru lāʿla kwəlu zarassaya wa-bāḥtu liqa manfas la-kwəlu ṣādəq
verses.notes: **No deed escapes judgment; the Lord is chief of spirits for all righteous.** Comprehensive judgment-formula.

verses.text_geez: ወይኤዝዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐት፡ በፍትሕ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ቃሎ፡ ለፈትዎ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘገብረ፡ ለመጠን፡ ሙስና፡ ኮኖ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəʾēzəz lāʿla kwəlu śərʿat ba-fətḥ ṣədq wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw qālo la-fatwo la-nafsu wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw la-maṭan zagabra la-maṭan musnā kono
verses.notes: **Divine impartiality of judgment.** No favoritism. cf. Deut 10:17, Acts 10:34, Rom 2:11.

verses.text_geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ አርእስቶ፡ ዘዘዘ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ ሕልዮ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ መልጥሕተ፡ ምንተ፡ ግብር፡ ዘጻድቅ፡ ወምንተ፡ ግብር፡ ዘርቱዕ፡ ወምንተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረሰየ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ ʾarʾəsto zazaza ʾəm-nə kiyāhu wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ ḥəlyo wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ malṭəḥta mənta gəbər zaṣādəq wa-mənta gəbər zarətuʿ wa-mənta kwənnānē ṣādəq lāʿla kwəlu gəbər lāʿla kwəlu zarassaya
verses.notes: **Divine bribery-impossibility, deception-impossibility.** Justice-formula intensifies.

verses.text_geez: ወወሀበ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ መዋዕለ፡ ስርየት፡ በዐመት፡ አሐዱ፡ ለትከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ቤዛ፡ ለኀጢአቶሙ፡ በዕለት፡ ስርየት፡ ለትትከስት፡ ዐመፃ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-wahabā la-ʾəsrāʾēl mawāʿəla səryat ba-ʿāmat ʾaḥadu la-tkawwən lomu bēzā la-ḫāṭiʾatomu ba-ʿəlat səryat la-tətkasat ʿamaḍā ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾatomu
verses.notes: **THE DAY OF ATONEMENT — Israel given one day of atonement per year for forgiveness of sins.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — YOM KIPPUR**: cf. Lev 16, Lev 23:26-32 (Day of Atonement legislation); cf. 11Q19 (Temple Scroll) cols 25-27 (Day of Atonement liturgy); cf. Heb 9-10 (Christ's atonement as Yom Kippur fulfillment); cf. m. Yoma. The aside on Yom Kippur prepares the Flood-as-atonement narrative.

verses.text_geez: ወእስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ይትፀመሙ፡ ለርእሰ፡ ይትዐቀቡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē yətḍammamu la-rəʾəsa yətʿaqqabu kwəlomu ṣādəqāna ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw
verses.notes: **Until judgment day, the righteous keep themselves from sin.** Bridge back to Noah-narrative.

verses.text_geez: ወባሕቱ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ኀርየ፡ ወአንቅሐ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ለትከውን፡ ምድር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ምስለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለትከውን፡ ሕያው፡ በዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለመኲንን፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ዘሰላም፡
verses.translit: wa-bāḥtu la-Noḫ ḫarya wa-ʾanqəḥa la-rəʾəsu la-tkawwən mədr bəʾəsita məsla Noḫ la-tkawwən ḥəyāw ba-za sabʾ la-makwannən ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣa kwənnānē zasalām
verses.notes: **Noah chosen and given grace — earth-as-wife / new-Adam typology for Noah.** Noah = new Adam after the cosmic-reset.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አጠፍኦ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘፈጠርኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ነስሕኩ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾaṭafəʾo la-kwəlu zafaṭarku lāʿla gaṣṣa mədr ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr ʾəsma nashku
verses.notes: **Divine decision to blot out, repeated.** cf. Gen 6:7, 13.

verses.text_geez: ወአዘዞ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ይግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ታቦተ፡ ከመ፡ ይድኅን፡ እምነ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾazazo la-Noḫ yəgbar lottu tābota kama yədḫən ʾəm-nə māya ʾāyəḫ
verses.notes: **God commands Noah to build the ark.** cf. Gen 6:14-16.

verses.text_geez: ወገብረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ታቦተ፡ በኵሉ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዞ፡ በ፪ ኅምስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዐመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዐመተ፡ ኅምስ፡
verses.translit: wa-gabra Noḫ tābota ba-kwəlu ba-kama ʾazazo ba-2 ḫəməs ʾiyobēləwu ba-rābəʿ sabuʿ ba-ʿamat qadāmāwi la-ʿāmata ḫəməsə
verses.notes: **Noah builds the ark — calendrically dated.** Jubilee 25, week 5, year 1. cf. Gen 6:22.

verses.text_geez: ወቦአ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዐመቱ፡ ዘሳድስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ እስከ፡ ዐሥር፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በ፪ ሰቡዕ፡ በ፪ ዓመት፡ በውእቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ ራብዕ፡ በ፲፮፡ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-boʾa ba-sadus ʿāmat la-ʿamatu zasādəs sabuʿ wəsta tābot ʾəska ʿaśr ʾiyobēləwu ba-2 sabuʿ ba-2 ʿāmat ba-wəʾtu warḫ rābəʿ ba-16 ʿəlat la-warḫ
verses.notes: **Noah enters the ark on the 17th day of the second month.** **MAJOR CALENDRICAL DATING — JUBILEES uses month 2 day 17 (matching Gen 7:11 MT) — calendrically aligned with the 364-day calendar.** cf. Gen 7:11.

verses.text_geez: ወአርኀወ፡ ሰማይ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማይ፡ ላዕሉ፡ ወማእምቃተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ተአንኮስቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ኀምሳ፡ መዐምቃተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarḫawa samāy ʾanqəʿta māy lāʿlu wa-māʾəmqāta ʿabayta taʾankostu ʾəm-nə mədr ʾəska ḫamsā maʿamqāta
verses.notes: **'The windows of heaven were opened, and the great deeps were broken up.'** cf. Gen 7:11 MT formula. **Jubilees specifies 'seven great deeps' (or similar number)** — apocalyptic elaboration.

verses.text_geez: ወአርኀወ፡ ሰማይ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ወወሀበ፡ ዝናመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ አርብዓ፡ መዓልተ፡ ወአርብዓ፡ ሌሊተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarḫawa samāy ʾanqəʿta wa-wahaba zənāma lāʿla mədr ʾarbəʿā maʿālta wa-ʾarbəʿā lēlita
verses.notes: **40 days and 40 nights of rain.** cf. Gen 7:12.

verses.text_geez: ወቆሙ፡ መዓምቃተ፡ ምድር፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እስከ፡ ዐሣ፡ ወምእት፡ መዓልት፡ ወቆመት፡ ምድር፡ ኵላ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጻ፡ ለማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-qomu maʿamqāta mədr kwəlomu ʾəska ʿaśā wa-məʾət maʿālt wa-qomat mədr kwəlā lāʿla gaṣṣā la-māy
verses.notes: **150 days of flood-waters.** cf. Gen 7:24.

verses.text_geez: ወቦአ፡ ማይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ አሐደ፡ ምእተ፡ ወኀምሳ፡ መዓልተ፡ ወወድቀ፡ ላዕለ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡
verses.translit: wa-boʾa māy lāʿla mədr ʾaḥada məʾəta wa-ḫamsā maʿālta wa-wadqa lāʿla ʾadbār zaʾArārāt
verses.notes: **Ark rests on Ararat.** cf. Gen 8:4. Following 364-day calendar dating.

verses.text_geez: ወአዕረፈት፡ ታቦት፡ ላዕለ፡ ደብር፡ ዘሉብር፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿrafat tābot lāʿla dabr zaLubar ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə ʾadbār zaʾArārāt
verses.notes: **Ark rests on MOUNT LUBAR — a Jubilees-distinctive geographical specification.** **Mount Lubar (ሉብር Lubar)** is one of the Ararat mountains in Jubilees-geography — appears here and in Jub 7:1, 7:17. Cross-corpus: cf. 1 En 65:7, 67:4 (Lubar mentioned); cf. 1QapGen 12:8-9 (Genesis Apocryphon — Noah builds altar on Lubar). **Mount Lubar = Mount of Mooring in early Aramaic exegesis.**

verses.text_geez: ወአልኀጹ፡ ማየ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ወአስተ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ምድር፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ወርኅ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዕለት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾalḫaḍu māya mədr ʾəm-nə mədr wa-ʾasta naqʿa mədr ba-qadāmāwi warḫ ba-qadāmāwi ʿəlat la-zəntu warḫ
verses.notes: **Waters subside; earth dries on month 1 day 1.** New-year's day = earth-emerges-from-waters = NEW CREATION echo. cf. Gen 8:13.

verses.text_geez: ወበ፲ ወ፯ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡ ካልእ፡ ይብስ፡ ምድር፡ ወበ፳ ወ፯ ዕለት፡ አርኀወ፡ ኖኅ፡ ታቦት፡ ወወፍአ፡ ለነ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-17 ʿəlat la-warḫ kāləʾ yəbs mədr wa-ba-27 ʿəlat ʾarḫawa Noḫ tābot wa-wafʾa lana
verses.notes: **Earth dry on month 2 day 17; ark opens on day 27.** Calendrical precision — Jubilees specifies exact 364-day-calendar dating for the post-Flood exit.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ታቦት፡ በወርኅ፡ ሣልስ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ለወርኅ፡ በሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ለወፂኦ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾa ʾəm-nə tābot ba-warḫ śāləs ba-qadāmāwi la-warḫ ba-śāləs la-warḫ la-waḍiʾo ʾəm-nə mədr
verses.notes: **Noah exits ark on first day of third month.** cf. Gen 8:14-19.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ አዝዝ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዋ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዕለት፡ ለዘ፪ ወርኅ፡ ለዓመተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕገ፡ ኪዳን፡ በከመ፡ ኮነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾəzəz la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama yəʿqəbwā la-zāti qadāmāwi ʿəlat la-za-2 warḫ la-ʿāmata kwəlu ḥəga kidān ba-kama kona mawāʿəla Noḫ
verses.notes: **MOSES COMMANDED TO MAKE THE ISRAELITES KEEP THE FIRST DAY OF MONTH 1 AS A COVENANT-MEMORIAL.** Flood-anniversary = covenant-renewal day. Picked up in Jub 6 immediately following as the Feast of Weeks calendrical-discussion. Closing of chapter 5; transition to chapter 6 covenant material.
